summary: One-frame event on the dropper when dropped entities finished moving ('shove-throw' step); built by esv::drop::DropEntityEndUpSystem::ProcessFinishedEvents.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: esv::inventory_transfer::TransferFinishedDescription (name from the IndexedStorage assert in ProcessFinishedEvents, EoCServer.dll+0x9A7AD0): +0 = the entity whose moving-finished event was processed (query entity).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: +8 = dword +8 of the entity's moving-finished event component (16-byte stride; a byte at +0xC of that event decides whether the entry is added).

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator FUN_142e36770 zeroes 16 bytes and registers destructor FUN_1405946c0 (frees an array buffer, no element destructors). ProcessFinishedEvents appends 16-byte TransferFinishedDescription elements (stride 0x10) to a HashMap<EntityHandle, DynamicArray<...>> keyed by the dropper. Live: heap pointer, capacity 1, size 1.
